issues.title: 1516: New asset styling, for info markers.

comments.body:
There is some trickery going on here @lebaphi .  I'd like to see if we can avoid it,

These info markers are different to the asset markers. We can make fresh requirements, if we want to.  What if our requirements are that they don't have a fill color?  Then I _guess_ the browser uses the `foreColor` when rendering.
yeah, I will find another better solution 👍🏻

Thanks :-)

But, as I said - I'm happy to consider changes to the image strategy, if that helps.
